title: Polished Brass Modern Retractable Wall Hook, 2-1/2 Inch Pull-Out, Wall-Mounted Brass Hook, Allied Brass
description: Modern retractable wall hook with 2-1/2 inches / 2-1/2-inch / 2.5in pull-out hanging space for bathroom towels, robes, and coats — available in Polished Brass, which brings warm, golden elegance that complements traditional faucets and classic bathroom fixtures. This wall-mounted hook (wall mount hook) retracts back into the wall to save space and keep a crisp, minimalist look. Use as a towel hook, bathroom hook, wall hook, or retractable towel holder for modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories. Brass construction. Fits standard interior walls; installs with included toggle bolts and mounting hardware. Installation requires drilling a 3/4 inch dia. hole through drywall plus 3 small holes. Holds up to 15 lb. Knob tip is removable so you can replace it with a cabinet knob of your choice. Overall size: 2 inches L x 2 inches H x 3.75 inches W. Backed by a lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
